headline: 0 on-chain addresses catalogued; Algorand not supported by DeFiPunkd read API; all sub-page fetches blocked

findings.text: D1: Algorand block explorer (algoexplorer.io) fetch returned permission-denied. No EVM-chain explorer applies. Algorand Application IDs and ASA IDs are integers, not 0x addresses — the DeFiPunkd read API does not support Algorand (chainId not in supported list). No name-tag addresses could be surfaced.

D2: lofty.ai main page fetched (JavaScript-rendered, no contract list visible). Sub-pages (lofty.ai/learn, lofty.ai/help/articles/8185869-lofty-smart-contracts) returned permission-denied. No deployed-contracts doc URL could be confirmed.
D3: No audit links recorded in protocol.audit_links. No audit PDF discovered from fetched sources. Cannot surface in-scope addresses.
D4: No GitHub repo recorded in protocol.github. Search for Lofty AI GitHub returned only an unrelated 'foresightanalytics' org (Algofi). No Lofty-specific deployment artifacts found.
D5: Single chain (Algorand). Algorand explorer fetch blocked. Zero addresses surfaced from any Algorand-specific source.

D6: No factory address discovered; cannot enumerate children. Each property is its own ASA (confirmed from search results), implying hundreds of individual ASA IDs exist, but none were surfaced from fetched sources.
D7: Role taxonomy cannot be populated — no addresses discovered.
D8: No addresses in admin_addresses[] — no fetched URL returned a confirmable Algorand Application ID or ASA ID for Lofty.

rationale.verdict: All direct fetch attempts for Algorand block explorer and Lofty sub-pages (docs, help, contracts) were blocked with permission-denied errors. The DeFiPunkd read API does not support Algorand. Search grounding confirmed the protocol architecture (one ASA per property on Algorand, WY DAO LLC per property, AMM liquidity pools) but returned no specific on-chain identifiers. Zero addresses could be catalogued this run.

evidence.shows: Lofty website is live; platform is a fractional real estate investing app; JavaScript-rendered, no contract addresses visible in page source

Lofty uses Algorand blockchain; tokens are Algorand Standard Assets (ASAs); users complete KYC and purchase property tokens; approximately 148 properties tokenized across 11 US states as of the case study date

Each property deed is held by a unique WY DAO LLC algorithmically managed through smart contracts on Algorand; platform includes AMM and liquidity pools; peer-to-peer transactions via smart contracts; Lofty claims not to custody user funds
Each property has its own ASA (Algorand Standard Asset); ownership represented by tokens in Algorand wallet; transactions publicly viewable on-chain

Each Lofty property is its own ASA with a unique ASA ID and token unit name; the first property was tokenized as an ASA on Algorand; ASA ID was referenced but not surfaced as a specific integer in the fetched snippet
DeFiLlama search snippet confirms Lofty is categorised as RWA / Real Estate on Algorand; fetch of the page itself failed (site unreachable)

protocol_metadata.about: Lofty is a fractional real estate investment platform built on the Algorand blockchain. Users complete KYC, then purchase property tokens (each an Algorand Standard Asset) representing membership interests in individual Wyoming DAO LLCs that hold property deeds. Token holders earn daily rental income proportional to their stake and can trade tokens on Lofty's secondary marketplace, which includes an automated market maker with liquidity pools. Minimum investment is $50 per token.
